# RideReady

> Free MTB suspension calculator. Enter your weight, fork/shock model, and riding style — get instant PSI, damping clicks and tyre pressure recommendations.

## About

RideReady helps mountain bike riders dial in their suspension setup in under 30 seconds. It covers the five major suspension brands (RockShox, Fox, Öhlins, DVO, Manitou) and calculates air pressure, target sag, and damping click starting points based on rider weight and riding style.

## What it does

- Fork and shock PSI calculator (weight-based, interpolated from manufacturer charts)
- Damping click recommendations (rebound, LSC, HSC) per model and ride style
- Tyre pressure calculator — front and rear, with terrain, width, and tubeless modifiers
- Sag verification guide with on-trail PSI corrector
- Suspension feel troubleshooter — 6 symptom cards with ordered trail-side fixes
- Cloud-synced saved setups (free account)

## Supported suspension

RockShox: SID, Judy, 30, 32, 35, Pike, Lyrik, Zeb, Boxxer — Deluxe, Super Deluxe, Vivid, Vivid Coil
Fox: 32, 34, 36, 38, 40 — Float DPS, Float X, Float X2, DHX, DHX Air
Öhlins: RXF 34, RXF 36 — TTX Air, TTX Coil
DVO: Diamond, Jade — Topaz, Jade Coil
Manitou: Mattoc, Mezzer — Mara, Mara Pro
